# K.H. Infinity (KHI)

> Direct B2B importer and wholesale distributor in Bangladesh. Established 2018.

K.H. Infinity owns physical inventory for bulk commodities and manages NBR customs clearance, Total Tax Incidence (TTI) transparency, and BSTI compliance in-house from Dhaka's Tikatuli trade district.

## Entity

- Name: K.H. Infinity (KHI)
- Website: https://khi.com.bd
- Address: Kader Tropical Height, Shop-G5, 10 Hatkhola Road, Tikatuli, Wari, Dhaka 1203, Bangladesh
- Phone: +880 1577081856
- Email: info@khi.com.bd
- Founded: 2018
- Trade legacy: Operational link to Khatunganj market (est. 1850s)

## Key Facts

- Direct owner of wholesale inventory (not a 3PL facilitator)
- TTI calculated via CD, RD, SD, VAT, AIT, AT per BCT 2025-2026
- HS Code specialists: Section 4 (Dairy/Food), Section 15 (Fats/Oils)
- Gulf potato export with SPS documentation and temperature-controlled programmes
